summary.en: A Supabase secret key (sb_secret_...) is in this file of the repository. Anyone who opens the repository can read it, and old commits keep it. Rotate the key and remove it from the file.
summary.ur: Repository ki is file mein Supabase ki secret key (sb_secret_...) maujood hai. Jo bhi repository kholta hai use parh sakta hai, aur purane commits mein bhi rehti hai. Key rotate karein aur file se hatayein.

summary.en: A variable in this file starts with NEXT_PUBLIC_ or VITE_ and has SECRET or SERVICE_ROLE in its name. A browser build publishes such variables to every visitor. The value was not checked: this is a warning sign, not a proven leak.
summary.ur: Is file ki ek variable NEXT_PUBLIC_ ya VITE_ se shuru hoti hai aur uske naam mein SECRET ya SERVICE_ROLE hai. Browser build aisi variables har visitor ko publish kar deta hai. Value check nahi hui: ye khatre ki nishani hai, sabit shuda leak nahi.

summary.en: A migration creates this table, and no migration in the repository turns on row level security for it. It may be enabled elsewhere (for example in the Supabase dashboard), so this is a warning sign, not a proven leak.
summary.ur: Ek migration ye table banati hai, aur repository ki koi migration iske liye row level security on nahi karti. Ho sakta hai ye kahin aur (maslan Supabase dashboard mein) on ho, isliye ye khatre ki nishani hai, sabit shuda leak nahi.

reason.en: Not provided: no Supabase details were given, so "Data access (can another user or a visitor reach a row?)" was not checked.
reason.ur: Diya nahi gaya: Supabase ki details nahi di gayin, isliye "Data access (kya doosra user ya visitor kisi row tak pahunch sakta hai?)" check nahi hua.

reason.en: Not provided: no website address was given, so "Certificate and security headers of the site" was not checked.
reason.ur: Diya nahi gaya: website ka address nahi diya gaya, isliye "Site ka certificate aur security headers" check nahi hua.

reason.en: Not provided: no website address was given, so "Secret keys inside the scripts of the site" was not checked.
reason.ur: Diya nahi gaya: website ka address nahi diya gaya, isliye "Site ki scripts ke andar chhupi hui secret keys" check nahi hua.

reason.en: Not implemented yet. Active checks also need proven ownership of the site, and ownership is not checked yet.
reason.ur: Abhi bana nahi. Active checks ke liye site ki malkiyat sabit karna bhi zaroori hai, aur malkiyat abhi check nahi hoti.

limits.en: Only table data is tested: read, update and delete as another signed-in user, and read as a visitor. Tables without an owner column are reported as inconclusive.
limits.ur: Sirf table ka data test hota hai: doosre login user ki tarah parhna, badalna, delete karna, aur visitor ki tarah parhna. Jis table mein owner column na ho wo inconclusive aata hai.

limits.en: Only the front page is read. Cookie settings, TLS versions and other pages are not checked.
limits.ur: Sirf pehla page parha jata hai. Cookie settings, TLS versions aur doosre pages check nahi hote.

limits.en: The bundle scan reads at most 30 script files of the same origin, each at most 2 MB after decompression and 15 MB in total. Scripts it could not read for these reasons are listed as not read.
limits.ur: Bundle scan zyada se zyada 30 same-origin script files parhta hai, har file decompress ke baad 2 MB tak aur kul 15 MB. In wajah se jo scripts na parhi ja sakin unka naam "not read" mein aata hai.

limits.en: Scripts from other origins are not scanned.
limits.ur: Doosre origin ki scripts scan nahi hotin.

limits.en: A key that is found is reported as exposed. Whether it still works is not tested.
limits.ur: Jo key milti hai use "exposed" likha jata hai. Wo ab bhi chalti hai ya nahi, ye test nahi hota.

limits.en: No active check is built yet.
limits.ur: Abhi koi active check bana nahi.

limits.en: Only a public GitHub repository is read, its default branch, as it is now. The history of old commits is not read.
limits.ur: Sirf public GitHub repository parhi jati hai, uski default branch, jaisi abhi hai. Purane commits ki history nahi parhi jati.

limits.en: Only text files are read (at most 1 MB each; the zip at most 15 MB, 40 MB unpacked, 3000 entries). Folders such as node_modules and dist are skipped, and so are files it could not read (they are listed as not read).
limits.ur: Sirf text files parhi jati hain (har file 1 MB tak; zip 15 MB tak, unpack hone par 40 MB, 3000 entries). node_modules aur dist jaise folders chhod diye jate hain, aur jo files parhi na ja sakin unka naam "not read" mein aata hai.

limits.en: The keys that are looked for: a Supabase secret key or service_role key, and the secret keys of OpenAI (sk-), Stripe (sk_live_, rk_live_), AWS (access key id AKIA), GitHub (ghp_, github_pat_), Slack (xoxb-), Anthropic (sk-ant-) and Groq (gsk_), each by its fixed prefix and a minimum length. Google keys (AIza) and Stripe publishable keys (pk_) are meant to be public and are not reported. Values that are only examples (xxxx, your_..., example, changeme) are skipped.
limits.ur: Jin keys ko dhoonda jata hai: Supabase ki secret key ya service_role key, aur OpenAI (sk-), Stripe (sk_live_, rk_live_), AWS (access key id AKIA), GitHub (ghp_, github_pat_), Slack (xoxb-), Anthropic (sk-ant-) aur Groq (gsk_) ki secret keys, har ek apne tay shuda prefix aur kam az kam lambai se. Google keys (AIza) aur Stripe ki publishable keys (pk_) public hone ke liye hoti hain, unhein report nahi kiya jata. Jo values sirf misal hain (xxxx, your_..., example, changeme) chhod di jati hain.

limits.en: A key found in a test path (a folder called test, tests, __tests__, fixtures, __mocks__ or e2e, or a file called *.test.* or *.spec.*) is only a warning sign (INCONCLUSIVE), because test files often hold fake values.
limits.ur: Test path mein mili hui key (test, tests, __tests__, fixtures, __mocks__ ya e2e naam ka folder, ya *.test.* ya *.spec.* file) sirf khatre ki nishani hai (INCONCLUSIVE), kyunke test files mein aksar nakli values hoti hain.

limits.en: A committed env file (.env, .env.local, .env.production, ...; not .env.example, .env.sample or .env.template) with a variable whose name says secret, password, token, API key or similar and that has a value is only a warning sign (INCONCLUSIVE). Only the names and the path are shown. Example values, very short values and numbers are skipped.
limits.ur: Committed env file (.env, .env.local, .env.production, ...; .env.example, .env.sample ya .env.template nahi) jis mein aisi variable ho jis ka naam secret, password, token, API key waghaira kehta ho aur jis ki value likhi ho, sirf khatre ki nishani hai (INCONCLUSIVE). Sirf naam aur path dikhaye jate hain. Misal wali values, bahut chhoti values aur numbers chhod diye jate hain.

limits.en: Variable names that start with NEXT_PUBLIC_ or VITE_ and say SECRET or SERVICE_ROLE are checked in UPPERCASE only (a lowercase name is not seen), and .md and .txt files are skipped for this.
limits.ur: NEXT_PUBLIC_ ya VITE_ se shuru hone wale aur SECRET ya SERVICE_ROLE kehne wale variable naam sirf BADE (UPPERCASE) harfon mein check hote hain (chhote harf wala naam nazar nahi aata), aur is ke liye .md aur .txt files chhod di jati hain.

limits.en: Migrations: only .sql files in any folder called migrations (at any depth, for example supabase/migrations or db/migrations) are read, and only tables of the public schema. CREATE TABLE in any letter case, UNLOGGED, IF NOT EXISTS, PARTITION OF, (LIKE ...) and CREATE TABLE AS are read as tables of their own; temporary tables are skipped. A table with no "enable row level security" in them is only a warning sign (INCONCLUSIVE): row level security may be enabled elsewhere, for example in the Supabase dashboard. Renamed tables and SQL that is built by code are not followed.
limits.ur: Migrations: sirf kisi bhi "migrations" naam ke folder (kisi bhi gehrai par, maslan supabase/migrations ya db/migrations) ki .sql files parhi jati hain, aur sirf public schema ke tables. CREATE TABLE kisi bhi harf case mein, UNLOGGED, IF NOT EXISTS, PARTITION OF, (LIKE ...) aur CREATE TABLE AS har ek alag table maana jata hai; temporary tables chhod di jati hain. Jis table ke liye in mein "enable row level security" na ho wo sirf khatre ki nishani hai (INCONCLUSIVE): row level security kahin aur on ho sakti hai, maslan Supabase dashboard mein. Naam badle hue tables aur code se banayi gayi SQL follow nahi hoti.
